title: What if the Sun vanished right now?
chunks: If the Sun vanished right now,
and twenty seconds to reach us,
so the Sun would keep shining
at the speed of light too.
at about thirty kilometers a second.

beats.vanished: the Sun gasps and pops; a dashed outline is left; a dark hole starts spreading through its light
beats.notice: Earth keeps smiling, eyes closed, no idea
beats.eight: timer pill pops in and counts toward 8:20; the 'last sunlight' ring keeps travelling out
beats.keep: thought bubble: the Sun still shining in a blue sky, the guy waves at it
beats.circling: wide view: Earth keeps moving along its dashed orbit
beats.empty: 'empty spot' label on the dashed outline
beats.gravity: a purple 'last gravity' ring appears riding with the light ring
beats.dark: both rings reach Earth, timer hits 8:20, Earth goes dark and gasps
beats.flies: Earth leaves the orbit on a straight dashed line; camera follows
beats.thirty: '≈ 30 km/s' label and a motion arrow
beats.week: '1 week later' pill; thermometer pops in next to Earth
beats.freezing: thermometer drops below 0 °C; Earth shivers, teeth chatter, frost sparkles
beats.liquid: cut-away bubble: ice on top, liquid water and a fish underneath
beats.warmed: heat squiggles rise from the seafloor; Earth relaxes a little
beats.subscribe: the Sun pops back, light floods out, Earth thaws and glides home; SUBSCRIBE button pops in
beats.whatifs: bell rings; button leaves; last frame = frame 0
